Focus.introduction: Gold Bridge Capital focuses on selected situations where assets, capital and counterparties need to be connected efficiently and confidentially. Our role is to help prepare the opportunity, identify potentially relevant parties and coordinate the path toward a possible transaction.

development.title: Projects seeking capital and partners.

introduction.first: Gold Bridge Capital focuses on preliminary transaction preparation, confidential introductions and coordination across selected private-market opportunities.
introduction.second: The answers below explain the general framework for asset-backed financing, hospitality real estate and hospitality development transactions.

collateral.question: What does Gold Bridge Capital do?
collateral.answer: Gold Bridge Capital acts as an independent transaction facilitator. We help prepare selected opportunities, identify potentially relevant counterparties and coordinate confidential introductions.

sale.question: Does Gold Bridge Capital provide financing directly?
sale.answer: No. Any financing would be provided by independent banks, lenders, private-credit providers or other professional financing counterparties.

custody.question: Does Gold Bridge Capital invest directly in hospitality projects?
custody.answer: Gold Bridge Capital does not currently represent itself as an investment fund or principal investor. We may facilitate introductions to potential investors, capital providers or strategic parties.

amount.question: Do you sell hotels or hospitality properties?
amount.answer: We may facilitate confidential introductions involving selected hospitality assets, subject to applicable law and the authority of the relevant owner or representative. Where regulated brokerage activity is required, appropriately authorised professionals must perform those activities.

term.question: Do you work with off-market opportunities?
term.answer: Yes. Selected privately introduced or off-market opportunities may be considered where the relevant owner or authorised representative has permitted confidential presentation.

pricing.question: Which hospitality projects may be considered?
pricing.answer: We may consider selected hotels, resorts, conversions, redevelopment projects, mixed-use hospitality, branded residences, development land and other credible projects with identifiable principals and sufficient supporting documentation.

timing.question: Can you introduce investors or capital for a hospitality development?
timing.answer: Potential introductions to suitable investors, lenders, joint-venture partners or strategic parties may be considered. No fundraising, financing or investment outcome can be guaranteed.

acceptance.question: Which digital assets may qualify for asset-backed financing?
acceptance.answer: Eligibility is determined entirely by the relevant independent financing institution and may depend on liquidity, volatility, custody, jurisdiction, compliance requirements and institutional policy.

repayment.question: Do you guarantee a buyer, investor, lender or transaction?
repayment.answer: No. Every opportunity remains subject to independent interest, assessment, due diligence, negotiation, applicable regulation and definitive agreements.

sidebar.title: Every transaction is different.
sidebar.text: If your opportunity does not fit neatly into one category, a preliminary confidential discussion may help determine whether it falls within the current focus of Gold Bridge Capital.

controller.introduction: The controller responsible for the processing of personal data through this website is:

data.title: 2. Personal data we collect
data.introduction: When you submit a confidential inquiry or contact us directly, we may collect the following information:

items.name: Your full name.
items.company: Your company, family office or organisation.
items.transaction: Information relating to the proposed transaction, including asset-backed financing requirements, hospitality properties, acquisition criteria or development opportunities.
items.gold: Information about proposed precious-metals or digital-asset collateral, including estimated value, location, custody arrangement, jurisdiction and ownership or source information where applicable.
items.message: Information you provide about ownership or authority, property or project characteristics, commercial objectives, financing or capital requirements, transaction rationale, operating information and any additional information you voluntarily provide in your inquiry or subsequent correspondence.

purpose.title: 3. How we use personal data
purpose.introduction: We process personal data only where necessary for the following purposes:

items.review: To receive, review and preliminarily assess confidential inquiries and proposed transactions.
items.response: To respond to questions and communicate with relevant principals, owners, sponsors, authorised representatives or other inquiry submitters.
items.communication: To prepare, coordinate or facilitate potential confidential introductions to relevant independent counterparties where appropriate.
items.security: To protect the website, communications and parties involved from misuse, fraud, unlawful activity or security threats.
items.legal: To comply with applicable legal, regulatory, compliance and record-keeping obligations and to protect legitimate business interests.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.text: Personal data submitted through the inquiry form is processed primarily because it is necessary to take steps at your request before potentially entering into a business relationship or considering a proposed transaction. Where appropriate, processing may also be based on our legitimate interests in responding to inquiries, evaluating opportunities, coordinating potential introductions, protecting our operations and complying with legal obligations.

recipients.title: 5. Recipients and service providers
recipients.introduction: Personal data may be made available only to parties that require it for the purposes described in this policy, including:

items.email: Email and communication service providers used to receive and respond to inquiries.
items.railway: Railway and its infrastructure providers, which host and operate the website.
items.professionals: Selected independent banks, lenders, investors, buyers, operators, professional advisers, service providers or other potential transaction counterparties where this is reasonably necessary to assess or progress a proposed transaction and where an appropriate basis for disclosure exists.
items.authorities: Public authorities where disclosure is required by law.

recipients.noSale: We do not sell personal data to third parties and do not share inquiry information indiscriminately.

transfers.title: 6. International data transfers
transfers.text: Some service providers may process information outside Slovenia or the European Economic Area. Where applicable, transfers are subject to appropriate safeguards required by data protection law.

retention.title: 7. Data retention
retention.text: Information submitted through a confidential inquiry is generally retained for no longer than 12 months after the last relevant communication, unless a longer period is necessary because a business relationship develops, legal or regulatory obligations apply, or information is required for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

rights.title: 8. Your data protection rights
rights.introduction: Subject to the conditions provided by applicable law, you may have the right to:

items.access: Request access to your personal data.
items.rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
items.erasure: Request deletion of your personal data.
items.objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests.
items.complaint: Lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

rights.contact: Requests concerning your personal data may be sent to the privacy contact stated below.

analytics.title: 9. Analytics and cookies
analytics.text: Google Analytics is used only after you consent to analytics technologies through the cookie banner. If you reject analytics, Google Analytics is not loaded. You can change your choice by clearing this website's stored data or browser storage.

security.title: 10. Data security
security.text: Reasonable technical and organisational measures are used to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Users should not submit passwords, seed phrases, private keys, login credentials, original ownership documents or highly sensitive due-diligence materials through the website inquiry form.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this policy
